instruction: When working with Vim, I want to highlight matching brackets and parentheses. Please search the web for how to enable bracket matching in Vim and configure it as the default setting in my local Vim.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

parameters.command:
cat > eval_showmatch__3ed25c6d.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if grep -q "set showmatch" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null || grep -q "set sm" ~/.vimrc 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Bracket Matching Enabled!"
else
    echo "Bracket matching not configured"
fi
EOF
chmod +x eval_showmatch__3ed25c6d.sh

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for how to enable bracket matching in Vim and adding 'set showmatch' (or abbreviated 'set sm') to ~/.vimrc. Evaluator checks if either command is present. Similar complexity to original (search tutorial, configure vim feature).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if showmatch is enabled in .vimrc, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the presence of 'set showmatch' or 'set sm' in ~/.vimrc file
Complete coverage: checks both full and abbreviated forms of the Vim setting
Data flow is correct: bash script executes grep → outputs success/failure message → metric checks for expected string
Postconfig appropriately creates verification script to check file contents
Expected value 'Bracket Matching Enabled!' correctly indicates successful configuration
Edge case handling: script handles missing .vimrc file with 2>/dev/null
